summary.text: Tom Blakely is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Bennington-5 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired information technology professional and business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include health care costs, affordable energy and housing.

paragraphs.text: Tom Blakely earned a high school diploma from Ansonia High School, an associate degree from Florida Community College at Jacksonville in 1977 and a bachelor's degree from the University of North Florida in 1979, and he also attended Emory University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he retired from a career in information technology in 2022 after working as an employee and consultant and starting several businesses, including a retail wine store, and that he was named Jacksonville, Florida, Small Business Leader of the Year in 2006.

Blakely said in the survey that he moved to Vermont 11 years ago and lives in Bennington, where he serves on the Town of Bennington Historic Preservation Commission and is a member of the Bennington Rotary and the Southwestern Vermont Chamber of Commerce.
He identified the cost of medical care and insurance, affordable and reliable energy including solar, wind and geothermal, and housing and education for working Vermonters among his priorities.
